author: Wilie
body:
Hello everyone, I'm currently looking for a team which I can have fun with and be competitive at the same time. I'll consider all teams.

Somethings about me.
I'm 14 years old.
I'm from portugal.
I'm very good in pvp.
I have lots of experience in various servers such as pot pvp, ocn, mcsg and hive. (All competitivevly)
I'm pretty chill and get along with most people.
I enjoy watching UFC and Football.
I practice football in one of the best teams in Portugal and I also do Jiu Jitsu as martial arts.
I have experience in ocn because I was invited to Gamemode1 back in the day I was a regular in OCN and I was also very good friends with most of the people in Impact currently. I still have many friends in OCN but I lost contact with most of them. Since I got banned in OCN, I have been playing in MCSG and Hive. I'm currently in the best clan for both EU (TriviumEU [MCSG] and Amnesty [HIVE])

Please consider me as I think I would benefit any team.

If you're interested in me either add me in skype -> pedro.ferreira.7 or leave your skype below.
Also, I'm open to being tried out as most people in this server might not recognize me.
